title: Translate experimental metric labels
changes: Translate Spanish labels for dynamically calculated Wasm and Cranelift experimental test metrics into English while preserving fixed historical claims, numeric formatting, code and ROM paths.
validation: rustfmt parsed both Rust files; formatting placeholders matched the tracked versions. Existing CRLF was normalized to LF after git diff --check flagged changed lines.
limitations: Experimental tests were not executed; several depend on a locally named ROM or write artifacts, and fixed historical claims remain unchanged.
